name: iqfred
caption:
SEASON 4 🎮🏀 We let Fred VanVleet walk to Houston. Then we paid Immanuel Quickley $175 million.

• Fred, season 4 with us (2019-20): 17.6 PPG, 6.6 APG, 1.9 SPG
• Quickley, season 4 with us, first 8 games: 17.4 PPG, 5.8 APG, 1.1 SPG
• Fred re-signed for 4 years, $85 million in 2020
• Quickley re-signed for 5 years, $175 million in 2024
• July 2023: Fred signs with Houston, 3 years, $130 million

Fred or Quickley? 👇

beats.head: FRED VS QUICKLEY
beats.name: FRED
beats.vo: We let Fred VanVleet walk to Houston. Then we paid Immanuel Quickley a hundred seventy-five million dollars.
beats.dlg: WE LET FRED WALK...|THEN PAID QUICKLEY $175M.

beats.head: FRED, SEASON 4
beats.name: FRED
beats.vo: Fred in his fourth season with us: seventeen point six points, six point six assists, almost two steals.

beats.head: QUICKLEY, SEASON 4
beats.name: IQ
beats.vo: Immanuel Quickley in his fourth season with us, through eight games: seventeen point four points, five point eight assists.

beats.head: THE MONEY
beats.name: IQ
beats.vo: Almost the same numbers. Fred got eighty-five million from us. Quickley got a hundred seventy-five.

beats.head: WHO'S BETTER?
beats.vo: Fred in season four, or Immanuel Quickley in season four? Comment below.

facts.claim: VanVleet joined Toronto in 2016 (2016-17 first season, so 2019-20 was his season 4); in November 2020 he re-signed for 4 years, $85 million ($85M); on July 7, 2023 he signed with Houston for 3 years, $130 million
Quickley was traded to Toronto on December 30, 2023 (2023-24 his first season with us, 2026-27 his season 4); on July 8, 2024 he re-signed for 5 years, $175 million ($175M)
